entry.title: The Valore Gallery
entry.desc: A room for every country in the library, plus the artist spotlights.
entry.howto.label: How to explore
entry.howto.desktop: Click and drag to look around. Click the floor to walk there, or use WASD / arrow keys (hold Shift to sprint). Click any piece on the wall to read about it.
entry.howto.mobile: Drag to look around. Tap the floor to walk there. Tap any piece on the wall to read about it.
hint.desktop: Drag to look · Click the floor to walk · Click a piece to read it
hint.mobile: Drag to look · Tap the floor to walk · Tap a piece to read it
